text:
sasha: Heads-up — trying to onboard hf model `big-chat-7b` and the HF->Redwood converter failed during safetensors merging. error: "shard index 5 out of range (num_shards=5)". happened on our CI when running `convert_hf_to_redwood --model big-chat-7b` :facepalm:

devon: ugh. that's the off-by-one shard check we've hit before. can you paste the exact converter command and the safetensors manifest from the HF repo?

sasha: command was `python -m redwood_converter.cli convert --src hf://big-chat-7b --dst /tmp/artifact`
here's the manifest snippet from the repo: `big-chat-7b-00001-of-00005.safetensors` through `-00005-of-00005.safetensors` (all present). CI output shows a mismatch when concatenating, then the converter tries to access index 5 (0-based?)

maria: sounds like two separate issues that surface together: (1) our converter expects 1-based shard counts in one place and 0-based in another, and (2) some HF uploads include an extra empty shard metadata entry in the index. we saw similar with the weights key rename codepath where a renamed key left a stub entry.

jon: also seeing failures on hub download for some org-scoped models if revision isn't pinned. CI fetches `hf://org/model` without `--revision` and the downloader falls back to `main` which sometimes has partial uploads (interrupted). we should recommend pinning to commit or tag in onboarding docs.

infra-bot: [artifact-download] started download of hf://big-chat-7b at revision main by sasha on ci-run-4182

liam: workaround: re-run converter with `--skip-shard-validate` to proceed, then run `safetensors-validate` on produced artifact before upload. not ideal but unblocks.

sasha: tried `--skip-shard-validate` — it made the run continue but final weights checksum mismatched and the model failed a tiny-lm eval (chat template mapping broken). stack trace shows weight shape mismatch for key `model.layers.12.attn.q_proj.weight` vs expected shape.

devon: that weight key rename path is probably the culprit: we attempted to normalize HF keys to Redwood canonical names with a regex that accidentally keeps both old and new keys when `--preserve-original` is set. quick check: does the repo have a `pytorch_model-00005-of-00005.safetensors` AND a `state_dict.safetensors`? duplicate sets can cause index math to be off.

sasha: repo files listed: `pytorch_model-00001-of-00005.safetensors` .. `00005`, plus `special_tokens_map.json`, `tokenizer_config.json`, and `README.md`. no `state_dict.safetensors` duplicates. converter log: "Found 6 metadata entries for safetensors shards, expected 5. using first 5, index 5 out of range"

maria: that's the extra metadata entry I mentioned. might be coming from HF's model card metadata (they include a separate metadata blob for quantized bitstreams sometimes). converter should filter metadata entries by extension matching the shard filenames. this feels like a parser bug.

devon: I pushed a small debug branch `convert/debug-filter-shards` to the internal repo: https://git.internal/redwood/convert/compare/debug-filter-shards. It 1) tightens the manifest filter to only entries ending with `.safetensors`, 2) fixes the off-by-one in shard indexing, and 3) normalizes weight rename mapping to collapse duplicate keys. can someone try it on CI?

sasha: kicked a CI run using that branch on the same PR -> ci-run-4183. converter completed without shard errors but now we have a tokenization regression: chat templates expecting `` as user/system delimiters are getting mapped wrong — token ids differ by +1.

jon: token id off-by-one probably from tokenizer config: `tokenizer_config.json` has `add_bos_token: false` but our converter injects a BOS by default for chat models. we should respect the config or add a `--force-bos` flag.

liam: note: also hit auth flakes when downloading large shards from HF during CI. logger shows 401 on one of the chunk requests and then retries succeed. Suggest adding exponential backoff + token refresh in the downloader.

devon: agreed. I'll add backoff and make the revision pinning explicit in the CLI: require `--revision` unless `--accept-unpinned` provided. plus add a preflight that verifies shard count == manifest count by matching filenames.

model-converter-bot: build 2234 of `convert` completed on branch `debug-filter-shards` (tests: +3 failing, +95 passing). failing tests: tokenizer-bos-behavior, key-rename-collapse, safetensors-manifest-filter.

maria: plan: (A) hotfix release with shard manifest filter and off-by-one fix, (B) enforce revision pinning in docs & CLI, (C) add `safetensors-validate` step in CI for onboarding jobs, (D) add testcases for HF uploads with extra metadata blobs. owners: devon (tooling), jon (downloader), liam (ci infra). estimate 2 days to patch + 1 day to roll to canary.

sasha: ack. will re-run onboarding tests after hotfix. thanks all :thumbsup:

devon: I'll open the PR for the hotfix and link it here once CI is green. expected PR id: #5298.

sasha: thanks — leaving notes in the onboarding playbook to pin revisions and run `safetensors-validate`.

jon: also adding a short section in docs about chat template tokenization pitfalls (BOS/EOS handling).

infra-bot: scheduled canary rollout of convert v2235 to staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC (owner: devon)

sasha: closing the loop here — reopening if regressions show up in the canary.
